contract.fitting_window: training interactions only; the ranking counts only the last window_days of them
contract.candidate_universe: items of the fitted training window
contract.seen_item_policy: items in the caller's seen pairs are never recommended
contract.cold_start: unknown users get the global popularity order; unknown items are never ranked and predict the training global mean
contract.ranking_score: interaction count in the last window_days of training; ties by ascending item_index
contract.rating_prediction: (item_rating_sum + smoothing * global_mean) / (item_count + smoothing) over all training rows, unclipped
